build_aot_function: build a python module that traces and compiles forward and backward graphs of a function using aot_function
build_aot_module: build a python module that traces and compiles an nn.Module using aot_module with forward and backward graph compilation
build_aot_module_simplified: build a python module that compiles an nn.Module with reduced overhead using aot_module_simplified for TorchDynamo frontends
create_joint_forward_backward: create a function that combines forward and backward passes into a joint graph using create_joint_forward_backward
clear_compile_cache: clear the AOT autograd compilation cache and reset recompilation count using clear_compile_cache
